text:
maya (GTM): Quick sync — AuroraMarket listing. Need: final launch checklist, benchmark narrative, inbound routing map, customer quote + demo slot. Who can take what?
liam (Growth): I9ll draft the benchmark narrative. Will use three production prompt mixes and a cost-per-1k-tokens comparison. Short TL;DR + hero stat.
samir (PMM): I9ll collect customer POV and ask for a short quote. Prefer the quote to highlight reliability under peak traffic.
julia (Partner Ops): I9ll re-confirm logo and press contact with the partner. Also ask for the single-paragraph customer blurb we can use.
noah (SalesOps): Routing plan: tag leads with `utm_source=auroramarket&utm_campaign=aurora-listing-q2` and route to aurora-sdr queue. SLA 24h for initial contact.
zoe (Comms): Assets: 1 long-form benchmark blog, 1 customer spotlight, 3 social cards, 2 short demo vids. Need hero stat and final headline by Thu EOD.
liam (Growth): Headline options: \u2014 "Ship production LLM features with predictable latency and 30\u0025 lower unit cost" \u2014 "Aurora + Redwood: production LLMs that scale" Pick one and I9ll finalize numbers.
samir (PMM): For the benchmark, emphasize realistic workload (multi-turn chat + retrieval calls), 95th pct latency, and cost per 10k prompt tokens. Avoid synthetic seq-len claims.
julia (Partner Ops): Partner asked for embargo: Do not publish until partner okays quote + legal signoff. I9ll get their final approval timeline.
noah (SalesOps): Example CRM mapping (sharing for ops):
```
utm_source=auroramarket&utm_campaign=aurora-listing-q2
lead.owner=aurora-sdr
lead.tags=["aurora","marketplace-listing"]
priority=normal
```
Please confirm team can consume via webhook.
zoe (Comms): Suggested social copy starter: "Now listed on AuroraMarket — teams can route inference with predictable latency SLOs and transparent unit economics. Read the benchmark: <shortlink>" Thoughts?
liam (Growth): Change to "predictable latency SLOs" — more precise. Also add the hero stat: "30\u0025 lower cost per 1k tokens on average across SaaS prompt mixes."
samir (PMM): Demo plan: 30-min live demo + partner Q&A. Internal dry run Wed. Prefer next Tue for customer-facing demo.
julia (Partner Ops): I9ll book internal dry run Wed 9am PT and partner demo Tue 11am PT. Invite sent.
noah (SalesOps): I'll add the webhook mapping to the CRM sandbox; will post test creds in #eng-infra when ready. Also — flag leads from Aurora with `partner:aurora` for PMM reporting.
zoe (Comms): Legal: need clearance on customer quote and logo usage. @legal-bot can you confirm SLAs for review?
legal-bot: Add to legal queue with partner consent doc. Standard review 48 hours for simple quotes.
maya (GTM): Owners recap: benchmark @liam, customer quote @samir + @julia, inbound routing @noah, comms assets @zoe, legal review @legal-bot. Update the shared launch checklist doc when you pick up task.
liam (Growth): I9ll upload first draft benchmark to the PRD folder by Tue morning.
samir (PMM): Reaching out to customer now for quote and short case note.
julia (Partner Ops): Partner confirmed they can sign off within 48 hrs once we send the one-pager. Drafting and sharing now.
noah (SalesOps): Routing test scheduled for Thurs in CRM sandbox. Will share webhook sample and a test payload.
zoe (Comms): I9ll drop hero image comps and three social tile mocks in #marketing-assets tonight.
maya (GTM): Great. If anything slips, call it out here. Goal is soft-launch + Aurora listing next week. :rocket:
